text: Boil the finely divided substance with about one eighth its bulk of pure hydrochloric acid.
translation: Boil the finely divided substance with about one eighth its bulk of pure hydrochloric acid.

text: Add from time to time potassium chloride until the solids are reduced to a straw yellow fluid.
translation: Add from time to time potassium chloride until the solids are reduced to a straw yellow fluid.
